content_of_post_to_answer: What is one daily practice that helps you become a better version of yourself without feeling overwhelmed?
answer: A practice that changed the way I approach self-improvement is a short daily review: asking what I learned, what drained me, and what one small adjustment I can make tomorrow. The overlooked part is that growth is not always about adding better habits; often it comes from noticing patterns. A person who pays attention to their own behavior can improve without turning life into another demanding project.
